conclusion: Ghidra direct-displacement scans across all 31 exact city-table-base materializer owners found no direct +0x3C write in 1817 instructions. A generated-body review matched all 31 owners and enumerated 39 non-stack stores; none has a locally resolved destination at city row +0x3C or an overlapping word. At 0x82E57980, the store destination remains behind an unresolved argument-derived pointer chain, so a city alias is not excluded. The separate loop at 0x82E8AEC8 writes city-row fields +0xB0, +0xB4, and +0xB8 for 128 stride positions; their meanings and consumers remain unknown. No city +0x3C source, cost activation, or visible effect is established.
